simple: Secure web gateway (SWG) and cloud application control (CASB): blocks malicious and risky sites using Trend reputation, controls access to SaaS and actions in it, and shows who goes where on the internet. Sandboxing of suspicious files costs extra; GenAI service control with prompt inspection is separate (AI Secure Access). Part of TrendAI Vision One Zero Trust Secure Access (ZTSA): with or without an agent, for corporate and personal devices; access is revoked dynamically when the user or device risk score rises. Part of the TrendAI Vision One platform (Trend Micro’s business unit, formerly Trend Vision One); licensed with TrendAI Flex credits that can be reallocated across platform solutions.
